name: agentic-id
description: One open ID for every person, company and agent. Resolve any person or company to one stable ID, with the evidence behind the match, then enrich, find, discover and validate with the five Agentic ID tools. Credit-aware skills, a lead-qualification agent and a local, PII-free usage log.

api_key.title: Agentic ID API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in with your iCustomer account (run /mcp, pick agentic-id, choose Authenticate). For CI and headless runs, paste an ic-live- key: Claude Code keeps it in your system keychain and sends it only to the Agentic ID server, as the x-api-key header.
